summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all eight source paragraphs. Their English covers the clauses and preserves the conditional judgments, uncertainty, impossibility statement, negations, and policy-compliant servant and repentance terminology. Both require source-note revisions to distinguish an editorial supplement and disclose the reported local mountain alternative. These findings do not require replacing the selected working readings. Proposed corrections require fresh review; this assessment does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation.
